svg.title: Two ECG loads through gem5 O3 and the cache hierarchy
svg.desc: Five compact bands separate the instruction contract, two explicit frontend lanes, the I0 record Request and response, the dependent I1 property Request and response, and in-order ROB retirement.
svg.text: Two ECG loads through gem5 O3 and the cache hierarchy
Adjacency entry 4->7 maps to internal 8->18, property 0x80000048, and LLC line 0x80000040.
I0 produces the physical-register operand consumed by I1
Fetch | Decode | Rename | IEW; I1 waits for P17
I0 RECORD REQUEST: ISSUE TO P17 WRITEBACK
FlowThrough applies to the record Request only
I0 record Request and response | per adjacency entry
I1 PROPERTY REQUEST AND P21 WRITEBACK
P17 wakeup; ReuseBind applies to the property Request only

path.data-flow-label: I1 property Request + ReuseBind and response

svg.text: I1 property Request + ReuseBind and response | per governed property load
Commit follows return; effects remain request-specific
I0 FlowThrough: record-miss LLC allocation only
I1 ReuseBind: matching property-line metadata only
native replay, squash, fault, and retirement rules
neither mechanism changes the loaded property value
